_comment: Findings the release safety gate should not block on.
Every entry needs a reason. The gate prints what it suppressed on every run,
so an allowlist entry is a documented decision, never an invisible one.
Suppress a specific path and check. Never suppress a check globally.

Correct and intended. Community and security policy documents must carry a real maintainer address: a code of conduct with no reporting address and a security policy with no disclosure address are useless. This is the project's own contact, not a vendor address baked into mail a self-hoster sends to their users. Verified 2026-08-15.
